scope: Show Info read-only tmux-mosh inventory and separate server/client ownership

behaviors.contract: The tmux server has merged server/listener properties, not the selected client's session/pane; sessions and all attached clients have separately labelled metadata groups, while the selected client's connection fields belong to its own Session dropdown and match its exact PID and start time

A collapsed-by-default rose-grey Session field shows the client's session name directly after Desktop file. Expanding it reveals the client's tmux session, pane and connection fields without duplicating them in the main process details. Generic executable/install fields, parent value-column alignment, independent collapse state and continuous selection/copy order are preserved; a missing anchor appends the Session field instead of hiding it.

Internal app_build_unknown and app_outdated booleans are not displayed at client, session or nested guest scope, regardless of their value. Raw inventory, real build evidence, frontend status and distinct sizing state are retained.

Server builds, detached sessions, frontend identities, local/Mosh/SSH transport, sizing ownership, input idle versus packet ages, all four verified socket columns and extra guest fields retain their own meaning and displayed dates use DD-MM-YYYY

Canonical tmux/network socket fields replace legacy socket/address/port/inode aliases, session and pane identity fields appear once and frontend metadata is omitted only when its exact PID/start-time pair is already represented; unrelated equal or unknown values and distinct states are preserved

The server's Tmux role, Tmux listener, Host, Snapshot captured, Sizing monitor running, Session count and Client count form an ordered flat block immediately after Desktop file. Existing values, rose-grey context labels, version freshness, build metadata, session/client dropdowns and failure reporting are preserved; absent desktop anchors do not drop any fields.

Server metadata is merged into the main process fields, not a nested Tmux server group; versions and outdated status are not repeated, distinct running/installed SHA256 hashes sit beside their ELF build IDs, existing comparison colours and future fields survive and failures or stale identities cannot supply another server's data
Collection is lazy, background, one-shot and bounded; concurrent requests share work, complete snapshots do not expire on a render timer, new Info captures are fresh and dropdown state is independent

Only clients --json is invoked for the exact owned socket and captured server identity; changed servers, malformed/oversized metadata and ambiguous identities are rejected, failures stay visible and no update/cleanup/attach/sizing operation runs

Application-specific tmux session, pane, client/server role and SSH/Mosh connection fields use rose-grey labels, including nested guest records. Generic OS process fields (PID, parent PID, start time, working directory and process command line) remain green-grey, as do running versions, hashes, build status and binary dates. Scope follows source schema keys rather than formatted labels, while installed build records retain installation labels. Values, ownership, ordering, deduplication and update actions do not change.
